_about: Hand-made Bidding War categories: short, specific lists (5-20 answers) a team can get through in a minute. Every list is checked against the source named; stats lists carry an as_of date and need refreshing when they change. Answers are player (or manager) names; write 'Name|player-id' to pin an ambiguous name, 'Name|new' for someone the career data lacks. Categories with "answers_are": "clubs" take club names ('Name|Q-id' to pin). club_aliases adds nicknames so they can be typed. eras: 1 = pre-92, 2 = 92-99, 4 = 2000s, 8 = 2010s, 16 = 2020s.
